speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: The security landscape Singapore faces today is more complex than ever before.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: A strong and credible defence remains crucial for Singapore's security, independence and sovereignty.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Today, the Singapore Armed Forces (SAF) is a full-spectrum, networked force that is effective and flexible.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Its operational readiness has been validated by deployments around the world to support regional and international operations, such as our deployments to the anti-ISIS coalition in the Middle East, the anti-piracy forces in the Gulf of Aden and to various countries for humanitarian assistance and disaster relief operations.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: The SAF will continue to participate in such deployments as part of its efforts to contribute to international peace and stability.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: However, the operating environment for MINDEF and the SAF is changing rapidly.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Technologies that used to be the domain of professional militaries are becoming cheaper and easier to obtain and used by less advanced militaries and non-state actors.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: As our economy and society rely more on technology that allows us to function with ease and efficiency, cyber criminals and attackers have more avenues to disrupt and destabilise Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Such technologies have the added benefit of greater precision while using less manpower, enabling the SAF to adapt to a shrinking workforce.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: MINDEF and the SAF will also develop new capabilities to defend against threats in the cyber domain.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: MINDEF recognises the importance of good stewardship in ensuring prudent spending.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: MINDEF takes a long-term view in developing the SAF's capabilities and will spend only what is needed to build up the SAF's capabilities to defend Singapore's sovereignty and security in an evolving and uncertain security environment.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: National Service (NS) remains the cornerstone of Singapore's defence and security.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: MINDEF has, therefore, invested significant effort into improving the NS experience.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Enlistment wait-time was reduced to allow more full-time National Servicemen (NSFs) to enter the workforce or further their studies earlier.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Career fairs were enhanced to include a wider range of companies and Institutes of Higher Learning.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: NSFs who are interested in a science and engineering career in the SAF can consider the enhanced Science and Engineering Scholarships.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: This year, we continue the CSNS implementation efforts by launching initiatives that support our National Servicemen and celebrate key milestones in their lives.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Gifts will be given to active National Servicemen who are newly married or have babies.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: We will provide basic life and personal accident insurance coverage for our National Servicemen.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: More National Servicemen who perform well during their NS training will receive gift vouchers to enjoy with their families.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: To encourage employers and businesses to step up support for their NSman employees, we will launch the "NS Mark", an accreditation scheme to recognise companies with supportive human resource practices.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Page: 26 NS has provided the backbone for Singapore's fighting force, ensuring that we have the security and stability necessary for Singapore's progress and prosperity.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: In 2017, we will celebrate the 50th anniversary of NS.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: We will plan a series of "NS50" activities to show appreciation and recognise the contributions of National Servicemen, past and present, as well as the wider community.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Singaporeans' continued support for NS is instrumental to ensure the peace and security of our country for the next 50 years and beyond.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: There is broad-based societal support for NS and the launch of the SAF Volunteer Corps (SAFVC) has enabled the broader community, including women, first generation permanent residents and new citizens, to contribute to Singapore's defence.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: The inaugural cohort of 226 SAFVC volunteers completed their Basic Training in 2015, and some have been deployed as Auxiliary Security Troopers and as Bridge Watchkeepers for navigational duties on board Landing Ship Tanks.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: We are heartened by the positive response and will expand our efforts for the SAFVC.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: Singapore will continue to work closely with our neighbours and regional partners to enhance regional stability and deal with common security challenges.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: As part of our efforts to deepen our network of bilateral partnerships, we will strengthen our cooperation with China through the 2014 Four-Point Consensus, implement the recently enhanced and revised Defence Cooperation Agreements with the US and India respectively, as well as conclude defence cooperation agreements with Australia as part of our Comprehensive Strategic Partnership.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: These partnerships help the SAF secure access to advanced defence technology as well as realistic and demanding training areas around the world.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: An open and robust regional security architecture is key to enhancing strategic trust and regional cooperation, to ensure continued peace and stability in our region.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: To this end, we will continue to work with partners to grow multilateral platforms, such as the Shangri-La Dialogue and the ASEAN Defence Ministers Meeting (ADMM)-Plus for strategic dialogue and practical cooperation.

speaker: The Minister for Defence (Dr Ng Eng Hen)
text: With the support and partnership of all Singaporeans, MINDEF and the SAF will continue to provide a strong defence to ensure our nation's peace and prosperity.
